shortDescription: Manage SmartOS virtual machines and zones

options.name: archive_on_delete
options.description: When enabled, the zone dataset is mounted on C(/zones/archive) upon removal.

options.name: autoboot
options.description: Whether or not a VM is booted when the system is rebooted.

options.name: boot
options.description: Set the boot order for KVM VMs.

options.name: brand
options.description: Type of virtual machine. The V(bhyve) option was added in community.general 0.2.0.

options.name: cpu_cap
options.description: Sets a limit on the amount of CPU time that can be used by a VM. Use V(0) for no cap.

options.name: cpu_shares
options.description: Sets a limit on the number of fair share scheduler (FSS) CPU shares for a VM. This limit is relative to all other VMs on the system.

options.name: cpu_type
options.description: Control the type of virtual CPU exposed to KVM VMs.

options.name: customer_metadata
options.description: Metadata to be set and associated with this VM, this contain customer modifiable keys.

options.name: delegate_dataset
options.description: Whether to delegate a ZFS dataset to an OS VM.

options.name: disk_driver
options.description: Default value for a virtual disk model for KVM guests.

options.name: disks
options.description: A list of disks to add, valid properties are documented in vmadm(1M).

options.name: dns_domain
options.description: Domain value for C(/etc/hosts).

options.name: docker
options.description: Docker images need this flag enabled along with the O(brand) set to C(lx).

options.name: filesystems
options.description: Mount additional filesystems into an OS VM.

options.name: firewall_enabled
options.description: Enables the firewall, allowing fwadm(1M) rules to be applied.

options.name: flexible_disk_size
options.description: This sets an upper bound for the amount of space that a bhyve instance may use for its disks and snapshots of those disks (in MiBs).

options.name: force
options.description: Force a particular action (in other words, stop or delete a VM).

options.name: fs_allowed
options.description: Comma separated list of filesystem types this zone is allowed to mount.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Zone/VM hostname.

options.name: image_uuid
options.description: Image UUID.

options.name: indestructible_delegated
options.description: Adds an C(@indestructible) snapshot to delegated datasets.

options.name: indestructible_zoneroot
options.description: Adds an C(@indestructible) snapshot to zoneroot.

options.name: internal_metadata
options.description: Metadata to be set and associated with this VM, this contains operator generated keys.

options.name: internal_metadata_namespace
options.description: List of namespaces to be set as C(internal_metadata-only); these namespaces come from O(internal_metadata) rather than O(customer_metadata).

options.name: kernel_version
options.description: Kernel version to emulate for LX VMs.

options.name: limit_priv
options.description: Set (comma separated) list of privileges the zone is allowed to use.

options.name: maintain_resolvers
options.description: Resolvers in C(/etc/resolv.conf) are updated when updating the O(resolvers) property.

options.name: max_locked_memory
options.description: Total amount of memory (in MiBs) on the host that can be locked by this VM.

options.name: max_lwps
options.description: Maximum number of lightweight processes this VM is allowed to have running.

options.name: max_physical_memory
options.description: Maximum amount of memory (in MiBs) on the host that the VM is allowed to use.

options.name: max_swap
options.description: Maximum amount of virtual memory (in MiBs) the VM is allowed to use.

options.name: mdata_exec_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds (or 0 to disable) for the C(svc:/smartdc/mdata:execute) service that runs user-scripts in the zone.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the VM. vmadm(1M) uses this as an optional name.

options.name: nic_driver
options.description: Default value for a virtual NIC model for KVM guests.

options.name: nics
options.description: A list of nics to add, valid properties are documented in vmadm(1M).

options.name: nowait
options.description: Consider the provisioning complete when the VM first starts, rather than when the VM has rebooted.

options.name: owner_uuid
options.description: Define the UUID of the owner of the VM.

options.name: qemu_extra_opts
options.description: Additional qemu cmdline arguments for KVM guests.

options.name: qemu_opts
options.description: Additional qemu arguments for KVM guests. This overwrites the default arguments provided by vmadm(1M) and should only be used for debugging.

options.name: quota
options.description: Quota on zone filesystems (in MiBs).

options.name: ram
options.description: Amount of virtual RAM for a KVM guest (in MiBs).

options.name: resolvers
options.description: List of resolvers to be put into C(/etc/resolv.conf).

options.name: routes
options.description: Dictionary that maps destinations to gateways, these are set as static routes in the VM.

options.name: spice_opts
options.description: Addition options for SPICE-enabled KVM VMs.

options.name: spice_password
options.description: Password required to connect to SPICE. By default no password is set. Please note this can be read from the Global Zone.

options.name: state
options.description: States for the VM to be in. Please note that V(present), V(stopped) and V(restarted) operate on a VM that is currently provisioned. V(present) means that the VM is created if it was absent, and that it is in a running state. V(absent) shutdowns the zone before removing it. V(stopped) means the zone is created if it does not exist already, before shutting it down.

options.name: tmpfs
options.description: Amount of memory (in MiBs) that is available in the VM for the C(/tmp) filesystem.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the VM. Can either be a full UUID or V(*) for all VMs.

options.name: vcpus
options.description: Number of virtual CPUs for a KVM guest.

options.name: vga
options.description: Specify VGA emulation used by KVM VMs.

options.name: virtio_txburst
options.description: Number of packets that can be sent in a single flush of the tx queue of virtio NICs.

options.name: virtio_txtimer
options.description: Timeout (in nanoseconds) for the TX timer of virtio NICs.

options.name: vnc_password
options.description: Password required to connect to VNC. By default no password is set. Please note this can be read from the Global Zone.

options.name: vnc_port
options.description: TCP port to listen of the VNC server. Or set V(0) for random, or V(-1) to disable.

options.name: zfs_data_compression
options.description: Specifies compression algorithm used for this VMs data dataset. This option only has effect on delegated datasets.

options.name: zfs_data_recsize
options.description: Suggested block size (power of 2) for files in the delegated dataset's filesystem.

options.name: zfs_filesystem_limit
options.description: Maximum number of filesystems the VM can have.

options.name: zfs_io_priority
options.description: IO throttle priority value relative to other VMs.

options.name: zfs_root_compression
options.description: Specifies compression algorithm used for this VMs root dataset. This option only has effect on the zoneroot dataset.

options.name: zfs_root_recsize
options.description: Suggested block size (power of 2) for files in the zoneroot dataset's filesystem.

options.name: zfs_snapshot_limit
options.description: Number of snapshots the VM can have.

options.name: zpool
options.description: ZFS pool the VM's zone dataset is created in.
